steps.expectedResult: Feature interface is displayed and accessible

steps.action: When user provides valid input meeting first criterion

scenarios.title: Successfully validate second acceptance criterion with valid configuration
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured

steps.action: When user initiates second criterion validation
When system checks second criterion requirements
steps.expectedResult: All requirements are met and verified

steps.action: When validation completes
steps.expectedResult: System confirms second criterion is satisfied

steps.action: Then user receives confirmation of successful validation
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation message displayed with validation details

scenarios.expectedResult: Second acceptance criterion is successfully validated and confirmed by system
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: driver.findElement(By.id('validate-criterion-2')).click(); WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, 10); wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(By.className('validation-success'))); assert driver.findElement(By.xpath('//div[@class="confirmation"]')).getText().contains('validated');

scenarios.title: Verify both acceptance criteria work together in complete workflow

When user completes second acceptance criterion

scenarios.expectedResult: Both acceptance criteria are validated successfully in complete workflow
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: Complete full workflow test; verify both AC1 and AC2 elements; assert final success state with driver.findElement(By.id('workflow-complete')).isDisplayed();

scenarios.title: System handles missing configuration for second acceptance criterion
